name: ai-developer-skill-plugin
description: Bundles nine Codex skills for web scraping, desktop/mobile apps, multi-DB analysis, manga-drama video production, and contract-driven Java work into a single installable plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Nine Codex skills in one plugin: scraping, apps, DBs, video.
interface.longDescription: AI Developer Skill Plugin is a personal Codex plugin that bundles nine curated skills into a single installable unit: anti-bot-web-scraper, desktop-app-dev, java-superpowers-contract, manga-drama-video, manga-drama-video-helper, mobile-app-dev, multi-db-analyzer, scraper-unblocker, and token-economizer. Use it when you need anti-bot web scraping, native desktop or mobile app development guidance, multi-database schema and SQL/NoSQL analysis, end-to-end AI manga-drama video pipelines, contract-driven Java engineering, or a global token-economizer that compresses Codex output. Each skill ships in its own folder under ./skills/ and can be invoked independently.
interface.defaultPrompt: List the skills bundled in this plugin and pick the right one for my task.
